#!/bin/bash
set -eu -o pipefail
root=/Volumes/KINGSTON/AIVERSE-builds/render-seven-integration
export JAVA_HOME=/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-11.jdk/Contents/Home
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/python@3.10/libexec/bin:$JAVA_HOME/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export AIVERSE_BACKGROUND=1
export AIVERSE_OPENARENA_BSP=/Volumes/KINGSTON/AIVERSE-builds/render-capabilities-20261125/oacmp1/content/maps/oacmpdm3.bsp
export AIVERSE_BSP_FRAME_PNG="$root/final-images/bsp.png"
export AIVERSE_TRIPLANAR_CAPTURE="$root/final-images/triplanar"
export AIVERSE_MATERIAL_TECHNIQUE_CAPTURE="$root/final-images/techniques"
export AIVERSE_PRISMA_COMPOSITOR_GPU=1
mkdir -p "$AIVERSE_TRIPLANAR_CAPTURE" "$AIVERSE_MATERIAL_TECHNIQUE_CAPTURE"
export AIVERSE_LENS_METAL_VALIDATE=1
git rev-parse HEAD
cmake -S . -B "$root/all-tests" -DAIVERSE_BUILD_STUDIO_HTML5=ON -DAIVERSE_STUDIO_WEB_DIST="$root/studio-qa-tree/apps/studio-web/dist"
echo "Full registered Mac quick suite"
if ! ./run-tests.sh --quick --jobs 8 --ctest-jobs 4 --build-dir "$root/all-tests" > "$root/refreshed-main-quick.log" 2>&1; then
  tail -75 "$root/refreshed-main-quick.log"
  exit 1
fi
tail -45 "$root/refreshed-main-quick.log"
echo "Metal opt-in tests on the combined source tree"
ctest --test-dir "$root/all-tests" --no-tests=error -R '^(quake3_bsp_frame|prisma_compositor_metal|model_triplanar_frame|material_technique_frame|lens_metal_frame)$' -V > "$root/refreshed-main-metal.log" 2>&1 || { tail -100 "$root/refreshed-main-metal.log"; exit 1; }
cat "$root/refreshed-main-metal.log"
if rg -q 'Skipped|Not Run' "$root/refreshed-main-metal.log"; then exit 1; fi
echo "Apple Silicon shared renderer, three language integrations"
cmake --build "$root/sdk-arm64" --target aiverse_render_jni --parallel 3 > "$root/final-sdk-build.log" 2>&1
PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" /usr/bin/python3 tests/render_sdk/languages.py "$root/sdk-arm64/sdk/render/libaiverse_render.dylib" --work "$root/sdk-arm64/tmp"
/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/bin/python3 tools/site/build.py check
